def number_to_words(n):
    if not isinstance(n, int) or isinstance(n, bool):
        raise ValueError("Input must be an integer")
    if n < 0 or n > 999999999:
        raise ValueError("Input must be between 0 and 999999999")
    
    ones = ["zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine",
            "ten", "eleven", "twelve", "thirteen", "fourteen", "fifteen", "sixteen",
            "seventeen", " eighteen", "nineteen"]
    
    tens = ["", "", "twenty", "thirty", "forty", "fifty", "sixty", "seventy", "eighty", "ninety"]
    
    def convert_three_digits(num):
        if num == 0:
            return ""
        result = []
        hundreds = num // 100
        remainder = num % 100
        if hundreds > 0:
            result.append(ones[hundreds] + " hundred")
        if remainder > 0:
            if remainder < 20:
                result.append(ones[remainder])
            else:
                tens_digit = remainder // 10
                ones_digit = remainder % 10
                result.append(tens[tens_digit])
                if ones_digit > 0:
                    result[-1] = result[-1] + "-" + ones[ones_digit]
        return " ".join(result)
    
    if n == 0:
        return "zero"
    
    result = []
    millions = n // 1000000
    remainder_after_millions = n % 1000000
    thousands = remainder_after_millions // 1000
    remainder_after_thousands = remainder_after_millions % 1000
    
    if millions > 0:
        millions_words = convert_three_digits(millions)
        result.append(millions_words + " million")
    
    if thousands > 0:
        thousands_words = convert_three_digits(thousands)
        result.append(thousands_words + " thousand")
    
    remainder_words = convert_three_digits(remainder_after_thousands)
    if remainder_words:
        result.append(remainder_words)
    
    return " ".join(result)
